fee_baseline.policy: fee schedule is an input and must be refreshed when account tier or staking discount changes

measurement_contract.spread: full quoted spread in bps; round-trip model charges one full spread
measurement_contract.slippage: entry plus exit expected price impact beyond quoted half-spread
measurement_contract.live_depth: USD depth relevant to target notional; diagnostic/capacity input
measurement_contract.vwap: observed book VWAP impact; diagnostic used to derive/check slippage and not added twice
measurement_contract.funding: signed bps per hour for a long; positive means long pays
measurement_contract.basis: perp premium in bps versus verified spot; cost contribution is entry premium minus expected exit premium
measurement_contract.custody_redemption: explicit spot-only friction in bps when economically relevant
